title.narrative: Protection of Civilians and Humanitarian Actors through Life-saving Explosive Ordnance Risk Education in Sudan (UNITAMS)

description.narrative: UNMAS has supported the United Nations Integrated Transition Assistance Mission in Sudan (UNITAMS) since January 2021, providing mine action services as part of the mission’s mandate. Established in June 2020, UNITAMS aims to support Sudan’s democratic transition and comprehensive peace process.\nUNOPS works with UNMAS to address the threat of landmines and unexploded ordnance.\n
